notes.title: 100 Downloads Milestone!
notes.notes:
Thank you (all 100 of you) very much for this milestone! I only expected a couple of friends to give the Game a try and certaintly didn't expect it to pick up on Steam like it did!
It's especially great to see how a Game I believed to be hard, was beaten by so many people (See Achievement Stats). You're crazy! :)
